features: KEEP SHOOTING- Up to 512GB* capacity means you can shoot tons of photos and hours of Full HD video*** without changing your card.

description: Record your moments in Full HD with reliable SANDISK Ultra® GO SD cards. Ideal for compact and mid-range point-and-shoot cameras, they deliver enhanced performance and high capacities up to 512GB. And, with startling read speeds up to 190MB/s [128GB-512GB models] when used with a SANDISK® QuickFlowTM SD UHS-I Card USB-A Reader (sold separately), you’ll spend less time waiting for your photos and videos to transfer, and more time capturing your latest inspiration. Journey fearlessly knowing your card is waterproof, temperature proof, X-ray proof, drop proof, magnet proof, humidity proof, wear out proof, and shock proof, and backed by a 10-year limited warranty for extra peace of mind. Plus, easily back up, organize, and transfer your photos and videos with the SANDISK® Memory ZoneTM desktop app.
